description: Election Commission - Mr. S. Kithsiri of the Tangalle Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Tangalle Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for local authorities, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
